added_at.description: When it first signed you in, or was linked.

current.description: true for the one this session signed in with: it cannot be removed from this session.

id.description: The sign-in's ID: derived from the account at the provider, never the account itself.

last_used_at.description: When it last signed you in; absent when it never has.

linked_at.description: When you linked it to your account; absent for the one you joined or set up Fyniq with.

provider.description: The sign-in provider the account is at.

provider_name.description: The provider's name as the sign-in page shows it; its ID when it is no longer offered.
